description: Epicenter Settings (the `home` window). It administers this app's active local transcription model through the transcription plugin: which model is active, downloading model files, removing them, and showing their folders, and the unload policy (ADR-0180); model identity is administration data, so `get_active_model` is granted here and nowhere else. It signs the app in and out and shows who it is signed in as (ADR-0558): each is one fixed `epicenter auth` invocation with `--desktop`, and the shell opens only the deployment's authorization page the CLI names; no token reaches the page. Its page is served on the epicenter-app scheme, so the capability is local (ADR-0561).
